meta.recency: w=0.5**((1-q)/0.15), q=game position in agent log; recent window q>=0.8
meta.outcome_inference: game end states inferred from last logged turn: our accept=known; trace ending on our offer/counter with rounds remaining=opponent accepted (they_acc); at horizon=ambig (scored as deal, flagged); ending on our reject=no_deal. Shares: bargaining=fraction of pie (nominal+discounted); negotiation=fraction of visible ZOPA (CI only).
meta.caveat: accepted-early games censor opponent endpoints; dossier endpoints are lower bounds for conceders
meta.replay_note: replay_verdicts computed 2026-08-16 from full-file offline replay; both levers FAILED the honest gate - see fields

neg_conditional_accept_bar.verdict: DOES NOT SURVIVE REPLAY - do not ship, do not spend a live trial
neg_conditional_accept_bar.lever: raise CI accept floor 0.5 -> 0.675 vs dossier-soft opponents while their concession trace rises and >=2 rounds remain
neg_conditional_accept_bar.scope_tested: CI, mr>1, named opp n>=20, accepted share in [0.45,0.675), >=2 rounds left; recency w=0.5**((1-q)/0.15)
why_it_fails: VOLUME: in-scope accepts = 75 of 8765 recent neg games (0.86%); recency-weighted +EV subset = 0.03% of neg volume
NO SOFT OPPONENTS: recency-weighted revealed endpoints are 0.34-0.59 for every named opp (thesis 'Ira/Iry 0.63-0.65 book' does not replicate; Ira/buyer endpoint=0.463)

HOLD-VALUE <= ACCEPT: with baseline-calibrated P(no-deal|ambiguous wire end)~0.49, hold-to-wire value vs accept-at-~0.51: Ira -0.051, Iry -0.044, Rubinstein -0.068, Godel -0.023, Priori -0.039, QuadrupleTriple -0.015, Kairos -0.015, Scarlett -0.031, HAWK -0.020; only 'agent'/buyer +0.042 (n_inscope=8) and zoro/seller +0.108 (n=1)

BREAK-EVEN: lever is +EV only if true P(no-deal|wire-ambiguous end) < x*=0.453 (weighted mean); baseline calibration puts it ~0.49; sound mid-horizon capitulations are only 33% of held games - the other 67% end at the wire where the outcome is OFFLINE-UNOBSERVABLE
CEILING: even at P(no-deal)=0 the family gain caps at +0.0034 share (~+4 family pts, ~+1.4 account) - 10x below live-DiD detectability (+0.033 family share) and under the +/-0.04 noise floor
neg_conditional_accept_bar.residual_risk_note: the one thing replay cannot resolve is P(opponent accepts our ~0.93 wire counter); but even resolving it in our favor cannot clear detectability - a live DiD would be wasted
neg_conditional_accept_bar.consistency: confirms memory glee-negotiation-ci-accept: neg fair-share floor at 0.5 is at frontier; accepted-share median pinned at 0.5 is NOT a leak vs these opponents

pers_per_buyer_push.verdict: DOES NOT SURVIVE THE CLEAN GATE - naive replay gain is inflated by reverse causality; residual scoped version is lab-DiD-only, not carrier-ready

pers_per_buyer_push.naive_replay_trap: unconditioned replay said +0.124 family sale-rate - not credible; two mechanisms inflate it: (1) pers_push_warmup holds lows honest until the buyer's first purchase, so compliant buyers CAUSE high push (reverse causality), (2) cell mix (p, v/price) confounds follow with push
